main_text.p: Tum in naturalium rerum & noftri ipfius accurata magis cognitione, ut omnium, quæ ullo fenfu evenire percipimus, caufam aliquam naturalem & ordinariam quomodocunque etiam probabilem concipamus, ne omnia fpeëtris & præftigiis afcribamus. Et denique ut illas paffiones occafionefque omnes fugiamus, quibus Diabolus noftræ crudelitati laqueos tendit, quibusque innexos ad regnum fuum perducere valet. Quod feliciter ut cuivis fuccedat fecit PATER ISTE OMNIS LUMINIS & GRATIÆ & ANGELUS ILLE MAGNUS FOEDERIS, & SPIRITUS OMNIS VERITATIS, QUI TESTIFICATUR SPIRITUI NOSTRO NOS ESSE DEI FILIOS. DEUS TRIUNUS & BENEDICTUS,
CUI UNICO SIT OMNIS LAUS & GLORIA IN OMNIA SECULA.

page.notes: Lower part of the page is cut off; the final line continues beyond this scan. Some words in the first lines are damaged; "fuccedat faxit" reads as printed ("faxit" partly unclear). Long s rendered as s throughout. The text is in italic capitals; "&" is the ampersand-like ligature printed as "&" in the source (shown as "ȣ" in the scan). The word at lower right is printed in bold roman, not a catchword of the gathering; it is transcribed as printed. The page is otherwise blank.
